# context-handoff

> A Claude Code plugin that shows what each turn costs, writes a handoff note when a session grows too big or too expensive, and resumes from that note after /clear. Python 3.10+ standard library only, MIT licence, runs locally.

Every Claude Code turn re-sends the whole conversation. After the one-hour prompt cache expires, the next turn re-writes the whole context at 2x the input price (about $3.20 for a 400K-token session on Claude Opus 5.5). context-handoff keeps sessions small: past 150K tokens, $0.50 a turn or $20 a session, Claude writes a handoff note at the end of the current task; after /clear, a SessionStart hook loads it and the user types "go".

Install in Claude Code:

    /plugin marketplace add YauhenBichel/context-handoff
    /plugin install context-handoff@context-handoff

Cost report without the plugin: `pipx install context-handoff`, then `context-handoff report 14`.
